text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet triumphs in the Shuka Sho. 
Watching the rivalry between her and 
Vodka, the crowd goes wild with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan made up her mind. If just 
Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka clashing shoots 
anticipation for the race through the 
roof, then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We need to make even more headlines than 
those two. First, a run to remember at the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen! Together with 
Trainer, she fired herself up.
